answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 46386 Country: AU Title: Can i pay my zakat to my brother in law, who is on medication Question: My brother-in-law had both kidney failures. He had a kidney transplant. We collected Lillah, zakah, sadaqah etc for operation. Now after operation rest of life he has to take expensive medicines, which is cost 80000 Rs per year. His family’s total income per year is around 100000 Rs. Can I pay my zakah to my brother-in-law? Answer ID: 46386 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 958/746/D=1434) If your bahnoi (husband of your sister) is poor and eligible for zakah i.e. he does not own gold, silver, cash, or unnecessary goods (that are not used in daily life) equal to nisab which is 612 gram silver price then he shall be considered poor and eligible to receive zakah. You may give him zakah money for medicine. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
